seen.where: Gelders Archief, 0439 Huizen Waardenburg en Neerijnen, inv. 124, https://permalink.geldersarchief.nl/CA57BD7A9396402C8AFC64E42D37AC0E (viewer read in Chrome); APE record 0439-124 confirms the title.
seen.extent: 64 scans in the folder; 5 read (scans 1, 4, 20, 30, 55). Letters in French, e.g. 28 Jan 1730, 'L... 20 Janvier 1730', 'A la Haye 1730'.
seen.cipher: Clear French with cover letters for persons in the running text: 'F F est l'Ami du monde le plus genereux', 'E: E:', 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'F'. Signed 'Q: N:' on scans 4 and 20. No digit groups on the 5 scans read, and no decipherment or gloss on them. Cover names, not a letter cipher, on what was seen; the other 59 scans were not read.

searches.query: Hobbe van Aylva Joan Duncan brieven geheimschrift 1730 1731 huis Waardenburg Neerijnen archief
searches.result: Nothing on these letters: general Dutch cipher articles (Elizabeth Stuart, Gerbier) only.

searches.query: Geyl "Willem IV en Engeland" Duncan Vere Aylva 1730 1731 cijfer brieven prins van Oranje "Quem Nosti"
searches.result: Geyl's De Gids 1924 text opened: Duncan and d'Aylva named as influential, sources Huisarchief and PRO; no cipher, no Waardenburg, no 1730-31 letters.

searches.query: "Quem Nosti" Joan Duncan Willem IV brieven 1730 Aylva bedekte namen sleutel Rosendael Torck cifre
searches.result: Biography of Duncan as Raad en Requestmeester and STCN odes only; no edition or decipherment of these letters.

searches.query: "Huizen Waardenburg en Neerijnen" inventaris Van Aylva Willem IV brieven Duncan Vere gepubliceerd edition Geyl bron
searches.result: Jaarboek 1903 report on the Huisarchief and Geyl's English correspondence 1734-43 (later dates); no printing of inv. 124.

prior_art.decode: known.py on the harvested DECODE dump for Aylva, Hobbe van Aylva, Duncan and 0439: only this lead; Aylva hits are the 1795 family jargon list A35-488-1, another key.
prior_art.tomokiyo: No Cryptiana hit for Duncan, Aylva or Quem Nosti in the web searches run for this lead.
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry paper found for Duncan or Aylva by web search; known.py shows none in the repo for inv. 124. GL.htm itself was not opened.
prior_art.edition: No edition of inv. 124 found. Geyl's Engelsche correspondentie covers 1734-43, not 1730-31. Jaarboek 1903 (DBNL) describes Huisarchief no. 189, 'Quem Nosti' letters 1734-38 with a key to cover names, a separate series.
prior_art.literature: Geyl, De Gids 1924, has no cipher content on Duncan. One De Leeuw chapter (UvA PDF, text search) has no hit for Duncan, Aylva or 1730-31; the rest of that book was not searched.

vetting.key_check: Inv. 126 read in part and spot-matched only: E.E., F.F. and the capital letters on these leaves appear in its tables; no letter was read through with it.
vetting.key_in_volume: Gelders Archief 0439 inv. 126, 'Sleutels tot het geheimschrift, 1730, 1731', 20 scans online. Scan 1 'Extract uit het groot Chyffer': Rosendael E:E:, Veldwen D:D:, de Burggraaf C:C:, Torck F:F:, Chesterfield O, Walpole, Townshend and others. Scan 3: numbered list (30 de Hr v. Ittersum, 70 Deventer, 90 Swoll, 210 Pensioenen ...). Scan 9 'Supplement du Chiffre': A 42/43 to Z 88/89. Spot-matched, not applied in full.

seen.where: Gelders Archief, 0439 Huizen Waardenburg en Neerijnen, inventory row 125 in the viewer at https://www.geldersarchief.nl/bronnen/archieven?mizig=210&miadt=37&miaet=1&micode=0439&minr=4399997&miview=inv2 (read in Chrome); APE record 0439-125 confirms the title.
seen.extent: 134 scans in the folder; 6 read as rectos (scans 1, 2, 3, 61, 99, 125), scans 40, 80, 100 at low view. Dutch letters 'Doorluchtigste Prins' signed H. Vere, 's Hage 23 May and 4 Sept 1731; scan 125 is a clear French copy of a declaration on the Treaty of Seville.
seen.cipher: Clear Dutch with cover names in the running text: 'O' on scans 2 and 3 (key: Chesterfield), 'den Domeinraad' on scan 2 (key: the Vergadering van Holland), single capitals on scan 1. No digit groups on the scans read and no decipherment or gloss on them. Cover names on what was seen; the other scans were not read.
